text:
Having Heather as our live painter was one of the most special parts of our wedding day. It was truly unforgettable to watch her turn such a meaningful moment into a beautiful painting. Seeing it come together on canvas amazed not just us, but all of our guests- everyone was talking about it.
One of the most touching moments was when she included us by letting us add our own brushstrokes. That simple gesture made the artwork feel even more personal and emotional. The final piece is absolutely stunning. A one-of-a-kind keepsake we’ll treasure forever. Heather is not only incredibly talented, but also warm, kind, and an absolute joy to work with. We’re so grateful she was part of our special day!

owner_reply.text: Jessica!!! Thank you for taking the time to share your experience!! It was such a joy to work with you planning out your composition of your painting! I also really love how all the details in the painting show different parts of the venue and moments throughout the day. Thank you for trusting me with your vision and I am so blessed to have worked with you both! 💗💗

title: More Than Just a Painting
